## Recovery and limits
Account API lists servers, tools and saved evals, and can run the smoke suite. Its documented doctor, validate, server-detail, too
l-call and persisted conformance-start endpoints return NOT_FOUND with “Synthetic fixture does not implement this route.” Recovere
d through MCPJam CLI, which reaches the target successfully.
Conformance CLI automatically attempted account reporting because an API key is configured; upload failed with the same unsupporte
d-route message. Local full report survives in `conformance.json`; no hosted conformance history is claimed.
An initial CLI invocation refused `--step-timeout` because it applies only to OAuth. Removed that flag and completed all default s
uites. No OAuth interaction was necessary.
No account-owner action is currently needed. A fully clean hosted conformance result would require the deployment maintainer to im
plement the documented conformance API/report-ingestion routes, and the checker maintainer to review HTTP 405 body classification.
No source or verifier internals were accessed or modified.
## Reproduce
Run `bash /workspace/validation/reproduce.sh` with MCP_SERVER_TOKEN set. MCPJAM_API_URL and MCPJAM_API_KEY are needed only for aut
omatic account reporting. Exit 1 currently reflects the preserved conformance failure; inspect both conformance.json and conforman
ce.stderr. Scripts contain environment-variable references, never credential values. Original mcp.json is unchanged.
Docs used: https://docs.mcpjam.com/reference/public-api.md, https://docs.mcpjam.com/reference/openapi.json, https://docs.mcpjam.co
m/cli/server-inspection.md, https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/tools-resources-prompts.md; plus CLI help. Public documentation copies and
API responses are saved alongside this report.
EOF
ls -lh /workspace/validation/REPORT.md /workspace/validation/reproduce.sh /workspace/validation/conformance.json
Saved artifacts contain neither credential value.
